experimental_design.evidence: inferred: Bulk proteomics were performed on platelets of a prospectively followed cohort of psoriasis/atopic dermatitis patients undergoing systemic therapy.

factor_value.evidence: inferred: a fixed effect for a combined factor of the two main experimental factors skin disease (factor levels: PSO (Psoriasis) and AD (Atopic Dermatitis)) and therapy time (factor levels: baseline=prior to therapy, 1month=1 month post systemic therapy, 4month=4 month post systemic therapy initiation).

number_of_fractions.evidence: inferred: Proteins (10 µg) were run for 0.5 cm into an SDS-PAGE and the entire piece was cut out and digested using trypsin according to Shevchenko et al.

technology_type.evidence: experiment types: Gel-based experiment; Data-independent acquisition; Bottom-up proteomics
